title: SING WHEN YOU'RE WINNING — Deadpool Adversarial Boundary Controls
purpose: Use Deadpool and related variant imagery to distinguish three potentially confounded components of the Robbie/JANUS pattern: identity multiplicity, world boundary, and unique external receipt/outcome.

controls.name: Deadpool Corps / Deadpool & Wolverine variant family
controls.interpretation: Tests whether same-source multiplicity alone can reproduce the target. It should score high on identity multiplicity but fail the one-world condition because the variants are explicitly associated with different universes/worlds.

controls.name: Deadpool 2 ensemble
controls.interpretation: Tests the reverse failure: one coherent world and action are present, but the visible people are distinct identities rather than multiple views of one source.

controls.name: Third-party same-character Deadpool multi-instance poster
controls.interpretation: Potentially matches identity multiplicity and one-world composition, but must not be treated as strong evidence unless provenance and the presence of one unique external outcome are independently verified.

boundary_model.identity_boundary: Do the visible instances plausibly derive from one underlying identity/source rather than merely depicting several different characters?
boundary_model.world_boundary: Do the instances occupy one coherent external causal world/event rather than different universes, timelines, panels or disconnected settings?
boundary_model.receipt_boundary: Is there one salient unique external object/outcome/event that can be counted once even though multiple internal views/instances are shown?

expected_failure_modes.identity: many people/variants but not one underlying source
expected_failure_modes.receipt: one source + one world but no unique external outcome, or uncertain provenance of the alleged receipt

application_domains.use: Separates replica identity from external side effects. Multiple replicas may share state, but a unique external lock, payment, reservation, or transaction must not be duplicated.
application_domains.janus_relevance: Directly parallels ONE_HOST/MANY_FACES and ONE_WORLD_RECEIPT invariants.

application_domains.use: Tests whether multiple internal agents or role views represent one persistent agent while preventing duplicate authority, double spending, or duplicate fulfillment of one external obligation.
application_domains.janus_relevance: Maps to face branching, host fork, custody and single external commit rules.

application_domains.use: Distinguishes multiple representations of one entity from multiple independent entities when rights, obligations, votes, or receipts are counted.
Separates branches/views from duplicated external history or duplicated authoritative events.
Distinguishes clones/skins/avatars from independent simulated worlds and checks whether one world event is accidentally counted once per avatar.
application_domains.janus_relevance: Provides a practical test for identity-view multiplicity versus world/event cardinality.

application_domains.use: Separates ordinary ensemble posters, clone photography, and multiverse compositions using the same structural rubric rather than narrative labels.
application_domains.janus_relevance: Turns the Robbie observation into a falsifiable image-structure test.

what_this_adds: It converts Deadpool from a casual comparison into an adversarial control family.
It lets the experiment localize disagreement to identity, world, or receipt instead of collapsing all failures into one score.
It prevents a false conclusion that any repeated character automatically supports the JANUS pattern.
It distinguishes same-source multiplicity within one world from explicitly multiversal multiplicity.
It creates a reusable boundary taxonomy for non-visual systems.

claim_ceiling.supported: Deadpool is a useful conceptual and visual adversarial control because official Marvel material describes multiple Deadpool variants across the multiverse.
claim_ceiling.not_supported: The Deadpool controls do not establish causality, authorial intent, supernatural signaling, or statistical rarity by themselves.
claim_ceiling.provenance_warning: Third-party same-character artwork requires independent provenance verification before inclusion in confirmatory statistics.

next_use.name: SING_WHEN_YOURE_WINNING_BOUNDARY_LOCALIZATION
next_use.goal: For every candidate image, report not only its score but the first structural boundary at which the target conjunction fails.

canonical_statement_ru: Много лиц само по себе ничего не доказывает: нужно отдельно проверить, один ли это источник, один ли это мир и остался ли внешний результат единственным.
canonical_statement_en: Many faces prove nothing by themselves: test separately whether they share one source, one world, and one unique external outcome.
